facts.business: Bansal Roofing Products Limited is an integrated steel infrastructure solutions company engaged in the design, engineering, manufacturing, supply, and erection of Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEBs), heavy steel structures, solar module mounting structures, and other customized fabricated steel products for industrial, infrastructure, renewable energy, warehousing, logistics, commercial, and institutional sectors.
